Casse-tête de caisses : pousse toutes le: A crate puzzle: push every crate onto the yellow marks, one at a time, without ever being able to pull them. 40 hand-designed warehouses, sorted from easiest to hardest, that open one after another, and random warehouses that are always solvable. Crates slide with a wooden scrape, arrows, ZQSD, mouse or gamepad, unlimited step-by-step undo, full screen. Steps, pushes and a step record per level.
Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Clic ou Entrée : un autre au hasard: Click or Enter: another random one
Flèches ou ZQSD · Retour : annuler · R :: Arrows or ZQSD · Return: cancel · R: start again
Manette : croix ou stick pour marcher, B: Gamepad: d-pad or stick to walk, B undo, Y restart, A or Start next level.
On pousse une seule caisse à la fois. Un: We push only one crate at a time. A crate stuck in a corner will no longer come out: Return to cancel.
À la souris : clique à côté du personnag: With the mouse: click next to the character to move him to that side.
